_comment: Compressed on-disk size of the release APK, in bytes. Armed from CI run 34868113646 (commit 04ea42d), which was fully green: detekt, lintRelease, test + testDebugUnitTest and :app:assembleRelease all passed. The gate fails past 2% or 64 KiB over this, whichever is larger — so the effective ceiling is 2274441 bytes. Regenerate deliberately with: python3 tools/check-apk-size.py --apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk --update
